name: misarmail
description: Send email, run campaigns, manage contacts and automations, A/B test, and audit deliverability — from any AI assistant.

interface.longDescription:
MisarMail lets you run email from ChatGPT. Send transactional email, build and send marketing campaigns, manage contacts, templates and automations, run A/B tests, and check deliverability (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, warm-up and sender score) in plain language.

It is built for founders, marketers and developers who already send email through MisarMail. A MisarMail account is required, and actions only ever touch the signed-in account's own data.
defaultPrompt: Send a welcome email to a new subscriber.
Show me campaign analytics for this month.
List contacts who haven't opened an email in 90 days.

positive.prompt: Check whether jane@example.com is a valid, deliverable email address.
positive.expected_behavior: Report whether the syntax, MX records and disposable-domain checks pass for jane@example.com.

positive.prompt: Show me my 5 most recent email campaigns, including drafts.
positive.expected_behavior: Return up to five campaigns, drafts included, with name, subject and status.

positive.prompt: Add Jane Doe, jane@example.com, as a new contact.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm that a contact for jane@example.com was created.

positive.prompt: How did my emails perform over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Return sent, delivered, opened, clicked and bounced figures for the last 30 days.

positive.prompt: What is my current deliverability score and what is hurting it?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the 0-100 score, letter grade and the factors lowering it.

negative.description: General email-authentication question, no account action
negative.prompt: Explain what DMARC is and why it matters for email deliverability.

negative.description: Writing help only; nothing should be sent
negative.prompt: Write a friendly email inviting my team to lunch on Friday that I can paste into Outlook.

negative.description: Summarising text the user pasted, not their MisarMail inbox
negative.prompt: Summarize this email thread I pasted below and list the action items.

review.commerce_description: MisarMail does not sell, list or link to anything for purchase through the plugin, including its own plans. Template marketplace, plan upgrade and newsletter revenue tools are not offered in ChatGPT, and plan-limit messages carry no prices or checkout links.

publication.release_notes: Removes all commerce from the plugin: no template marketplace, plan upgrade or newsletter revenue tools, and no prices or checkout links in plan-limit messages.
